sessions.phase_label: Initial proofreading, NASM editing, and ALEKS guide assignment
Expanded document production and image-quality instructions
Deliverable completion and Texas study-guide creation

requirements.title: CHPN Tests 1–4 Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the content of CHPN tests 1 through 4.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently deliverable proofreading task; its delivery deadline is project-management information and is excluded.

requirements.title: Florida Real Estate Tests Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the Florida real estate test materials.
requirements.boundary_note: This task has its own artifact and completion trajectory, separate from the other proofreading assignments.

requirements.title: NASM CPT Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the assigned NASM CPT document content.
requirements.boundary_note: Proofreading is separated from heading correction and image addition because each output behavior can be assigned, canceled, or completed independently.

requirements.title: NASM CPT Heading Correction
requirements.definition: Correct the heading structure in the assigned NASM CPT document.
requirements.boundary_note: Heading correction is a document-structure change distinct from proofreading and image insertion, despite being listed in the same task line.

requirements.title: ALEKS Math Placement Study Guide
requirements.definition: Create ALEKS math placement review material using the specified concise topic-response format.
requirements.boundary_note: Word count, omission of introductions and conclusions, direct writing style, and the one-bullet rule are attributes of one study-guide creation mechanism.

requirements.title: LCSW Audiobook Formatting
requirements.definition: Format the assigned LCSW audiobook artifact.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a standalone formatting deliverable rather than a proofreading, image-production, or study-guide task.

requirements.title: Canada Citizenship Guide Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the designated Canada citizenship guide and record new proofreading comments in the selected document version.
requirements.boundary_note: The July 26 source document, disregard of existing comments, and addition of new comments are attributes of this proofreading task rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: M1 Motorcycle Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the assigned M1 motorcycle document.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independent proofreading deliverable even though no completion evidence appears in the supplied history.

requirements.title: Ontario Driver License Book Image Addition
requirements.definition: Add generated images to the Ontario driver license book.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement owns delivery of the Ontario book images; chapter coverage and image-spelling validation are independently applicable quality rules.

requirements.title: Book Images Begin at Chapter 1
requirements.definition: Begin image coverage at chapter 1 for each book unless the client gives an explicit exception for that particular book.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a reusable coverage rule that can change independently of any one image-delivery task; exceptions are book-specific and must not propagate.

requirements.title: Generated Image Spelling Validation
requirements.definition: Inspect each generated book image for spelling errors, regenerate erroneous images, and insert only validated images into the document.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently actionable image-quality acceptance rule; the suggested reading time and typical error count are guidance rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: NASM Tests 2–4 Question Spacing
requirements.definition: Correct question-spacing problems in NASM tests 2 through 4 and review the resulting PDF for that formatting outcome.
requirements.boundary_note: PDF review is treated as an acceptance step for the spacing correction, not as an independent generic QA Requirement.

requirements.title: Word-for-Word Proofreading Standard
requirements.definition: Perform proofreading by reading every passage and line word for word rather than relying on a cursory review.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a reusable proofreading acceptance standard and does not absorb the independently assigned document-specific proofreading deliverables.

requirements.title: Texas Driver License Study Guide
requirements.definition: Create the Texas driver license study guide using the specified concise 300-word topic-response format.
requirements.boundary_note: Word count, optional tables and bullets, omitted introduction and conclusion, and direct style are attributes of this guide-generation task.

requirements.title: New NASM CPT File Image Addition
requirements.definition: Add images to the designated NASM CPT document at eligible Heading 2 subheadings.
requirements.boundary_note: The eligible heading level is an attribute of this image-insertion task; general chapter-start and spelling-quality rules remain separate cross-book Requirements.

unresolved_candidates.description: The two initial NASM CPT task lines do not fully identify their document boundaries; proofreading, heading correction, and image addition are provisionally separated by independently actionable output behavior.
